# Verdant Signal

> Verdant Signal is a free procedural cozy science-fiction colony simulation for desktop and tablet
> browsers at https://propagate.world. Every colonist is an autonomous agent with rolled abilities and a
> persistent personality; the colony remembers itself between visits. Built by icyzh.

## What it is

- A single-page browser game with crisp pixel art, no install, account, or cost.
- Found a biosphere colony or assemble an alien scavenger crew. Both cultures have distinct environments,
  economies, music, and voice while sharing one deterministic simulation.
- Desktop and landscape tablets are supported; phones receive a lightweight title screen.

## How it works

- Colonists cultivate xenocrops, gather alien flora, build habitats, barter supplies, invent field
  technology, form bonds and grudges, elect leaders, and defend against scavenger incursions.
- Saves live in IndexedDB and return with a recap. Long-term memory can carry lore and lineages between
  colonies without entering the deterministic simulation loop.
- The same seed grows the same colony. Optional language-model channels enrich conversations and prose;
  authored fallbacks keep the complete game playable offline.
- Players can whisper a signal to a colonist. Whether they heed it is determined by their personality and
  the simulation, never by the language model.

## Facts

- Name: Verdant Signal.
- Play: https://propagate.world.
- Creator: icyzh — https://github.com/icyzh.
- Price: free. Platform: desktop and landscape-tablet web browsers. Mode: single player.
- Art: original procedural pixel sprites and original Verdant Signal key art.
- Genre: colony simulation, cozy science fiction, god game, agent-based simulation.

## Technology

- Vanilla JavaScript ES modules, Canvas 2D, and a clean nearest-neighbour WebGL display scaler; no build step.
- Deterministic seeded simulation with display, chat, and player-whisper side channels kept outside sim state.
- Browser-local IndexedDB saves use compare-and-set revisions; gameplay state is not stored server-side.

## FAQ

**Is Verdant Signal free?** Yes — no download, account, or ads.

**Does it use AI?** Each colonist is an autonomous simulation agent. Optional language models enrich
expressive text only; deterministic mechanics and offline fallbacks remain authoritative.

**Can I lose my colony?** Clearing browser site data erases local saves; otherwise the colony waits and
recaps what happened when you return.

**Is it multiplayer?** Single player, in a world of neighbouring colonies that can encounter and remember
one another.
